scope: Windows current GUI route: independently installed libVLC3 for general local media. The retained original implementation inventory below is reference/test evidence, not the active GUI route, an exact codec count or a parity claim.
vlcReference: Official VideoLAN libVLC3 public C ABI; selected runtime modules determine actual codec/profile support. Stock runtime is external for review and is not bundled.
verification: Native libVLC decoded/displayed counters, snapshots and per-case checks must pass for the exact Windows CI revision. Physical sound and DNS-SD discovery require separate device/network evidence.

entries.name: PCM WAVE
entries.originalPrototypeCoverage: Original integer PCM8/16/24/32, up to eight channels, with source-depth preserving WAVE export. Float WAVE and RF64 are not implemented.
entries.coverage: The Windows GUI delegates this family to the selected external runtime. The original prototype evidence below does not establish current native playback or physical output.

entries.name: G.711 A-law / μ-law
entries.originalPrototypeCoverage: Original exact sample reconstruction in supported WAVE, AIFC and AU carriers. Decoded output is16-bit PCM; audible Windows device output remains a separate check.

entries.name: H.264 / AVC Windows playback
entries.originalPrototypeCoverage: Native Windows CI verified synthetic AVC MP4/MKV video, B-frame seek/resume, modern Media Foundation HWND actual rendered frames, native Source Reader pixels, fullscreen and caption overlay. This is a system decoder route, not an original AVC decoder or general profile/container guarantee.

entries.name: Matroska AVC / HEVC + AAC-LC remux
entries.originalPrototypeCoverage: Original EBML demux and MP4 remux, one AVC/HEVC video, selectable mono/stereo/5.1 AAC-LC or audio off, and embedded plain text.512MiB/500,000 packets, known-size Clusters, bounded CFR reordering only. Independent macOS decode matched360 AVC frames,360 reordered AVC frames and60 frames each for HEVC8/10; AAC relative start was within25ms. Check the exact Windows artifact for native playback results.

entries.name: HEVC / H.265 container path
entries.originalPrototypeCoverage: Original bounded HEVC config/packet handling, MKV-to-MP4 mux and validated hev1-to-hvc1 compatibility copies. The modern engine and direct Source Reader both returned MF_E_TOPO_CODEC_NOT_FOUND (C00D5212) for HEVC8/10 on Windows CI. Installed Windows HEVC support is required; playback remains unverified. No original HEVC decoder or HDR guarantee.
